claims.assertion: Athena said authentic spacecraft encounters should produce lasting shock and emotional change; she argued that contact stories lacking these reactions may be invented with an agenda.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She presented this as a sign, not proof.

claims.assertion: Athena said official and widely accepted mystery sources are more controlled, with agencies supplying information they want the public to receive.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She claimed media coverage is broadly manipulated.

claims.assertion: Athena said a collective unconscious extends beyond Earth, linking humans across worlds and explaining why extraterrestrials may seem human.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
